title: Menara Kudus Mosque
scope: The Al-Aqsha mosque in Kauman, Kudus, including the silver-domed east entrance, the split brick gateway, the stepped brick minaret, and the prayer-hall roof behind them.
limitations: The front reaches, minaret registration, and hall links follow the surveyed site relationships and approximate roof controls. Separations and secondary volumes are estimates.
The exterior includes the historic minaret, photographed mosque entry and associated prayer hall. The cemetery and outlying auxiliary buildings are outside scope.
Small carved plaques, colours after subsequent repairs, and unpublished prayer-hall elevations are approximate.
